t: A low-power Bluetooth chip from Silicon Labs for beacons, tags, and coin-cell sensors.
steps: Buy the BGM220 Explorer Kit from SparkFun or a Thunderboard BG22 from Silicon Labs.
Get a USB cable that fits the kit.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the Silicon Labs Arduino core.
Install Simplicity Commander and the J-Link drivers.
Burn the Arduino bootloader onto the kit with Simplicity Commander.
Upload the Blink example to test the LED.
Try a Bluetooth example and find the board in a phone app.
meta: Open Board. From $12.45. A few stores.
